judgement.reason: Glance is a single Go web server; adding the config file to the image is a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the image starts with the configuration file /app/config/glance.yml (ENTRYPOINT or CMD in Dockerfile), and no Dockerfile instruction creates that file. Deployz does not mount configuration files.
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile only copies the binary and starts it with /app/config/glance.yml, and no shown line creates that file or supplies the configuration another way, so the app needs a mounted configuration file.
